rolloutOrder: requires:sat-engine release (claude/sat-engine: question_spr grading, KaTeX rendering, table and figure_svg rendering, official-domain filters) merged, Pages deployed and the sat-practice function deployed first
manualFollowUps: Order: ship the sat-engine release first (or in the same window, engine first). This migration publishes 46 grid-in items of type question_spr, LaTeX ($...$) prompts, 12 table items and 22 SVG figures; the currently deployed SAT Practice app and function cannot grade question_spr or render KaTeX, tables or figures, and select_sat_practice_questions serves every published question_% row, so pushing this before the engine would show learners raw LaTeX, missing charts and ungradable grid-ins.

Database: supabase db push --linked --include-all only from an isolated copy of the installed migrations plus 20261026141000_sat_practice_data_geometry.sql (and whatever sat-engine / sat-math-a migrations ship with it), keeping the 9 pending payment migrations from #220 (20261010162000-20261010174000) excluded. Dry run first, then supabase migration list --linked. Adds 2 parts under the SAT Practice Math section (Problem-Solving and Data Analysis display_order 12, Geometry and Trigonometry display_order 13) and 180 original questions (90 per domain; 134 question_single_choice, 46 question_spr) with answer keys. Idempotent: every insert is on conflict do nothing, ids are md5('schood-sat-part:'||domain) and md5('schood-sat-q:'||slug); the migration raises if the product, the Math section or either part is missing.

Source of truth: content/sat-practice/problem_solving_data_analysis.json and content/sat-practice/geometry_trigonometry.json. To change content, edit the JSON, run node scripts/content/validate-sat-practice.mjs content/sat-practice/*.json, then node scripts/content/sat-math-b.mjs and ship a new migration (this one never updates existing rows).
No Pages, Edge Function, worker or secret changes in this release.
verification: supabase migration list --linked shows 20261026141000 applied and the 9 #220 payment migrations still pending; the push log prints the notice 'SAT Practice Problem-Solving/Geometry questions present: 180 of 180'.

select u.metadata->>'sat_official_domain' d, u.type, count(*) from public.content_units u join public.parts p on p.id=u.part_id where p.section_id='bee41358-7368-5bbb-bb76-e42afe3c1c44' and u.metadata->>'content_revision'='original-2026-10-v2' and u.metadata->>'sat_official_domain' in ('problem_solving_data_analysis','geometry_trigonometry') group by 1,2 returns problem_solving_data_analysis/question_single_choice 67, problem_solving_data_analysis/question_spr 23, geometry_trigonometry/question_single_choice 67, geometry_trigonometry/question_spr 23; every one of those rows has an answer_keys row.

As a signed-in SAT Practice learner: a Math set filtered to Problem-Solving and Data Analysis or Geometry and Trigonometry shows the new questions with rendered math; psda-twovar-001 shows its scatterplot, psda-prob-002 its two-way table and geo-lines-018 its triangle figure, each readable at 320px; a grid-in item (original_slug geo-trig-010, accepted 5/12, .4166, .4167, 0.416, 0.417) grades 5/12 and .4167 as correct and .41 as incorrect.

rollback.migration: Do not delete (learner attempts may reference the rows). Retire instead: update public.content_units set metadata = metadata || '{"content_status":"retired","retired_in":"sat-practice-data-geometry-content"}'::jsonb where metadata->>'content_revision'='original-2026-10-v2' and metadata->>'sat_official_domain' in ('problem_solving_data_analysis','geometry_trigonometry'); select_sat_practice_questions skips retired rows.
